newsitem.title: USA: WHX mulls options in Dynamics offer.
newsitem.headline: WHX mulls options in Dynamics offer.

text.p: WHX Corp said Monday it would consider its options after its offer and a tender by rival CTS Corp to buy Dynamics Corp of America expired last Friday.
WHX, which owns 13.5 percent of Dynamics and bid $56 a share, said in a statement that it is considering two options:
-- Discussing a merger with Dynamics and CTS Corp, which owns 30.3 percent of Dynamics.
-- Appealing to Dynamics stockholders directly through a proxy solicitation and/or a new tender offer.

"In either case WHX's objective would be to obtain the highest possible price for Dynamics Corp's 44 percent investment in CTS and other assets, either from a cash transaction with WHX, or from a more advantageous economic transaction with CTS or a third party," the statement said.
It added that WHX also may consider other alternatives, like buying more Dynamics stock or selling its holdings.
Earlier today, CTS Corp said it completed its offer to buy Dynamics for $56.25 a share in cash, with 1.2 million -- or 30.3 percent of all outstanding Dynamics shares -- tendered.

All shares not tendered will be converted into 0.88 shares of CTS common stock and Dynamics will become a wholly-owned subsidiary of CTS, the company said, adding that it expected the merger to be completed this summer.
In late afternoon trading Dynamics was at 58, up 1-1/2, CTS at 67-5/8, up 2-1/2 and WHX at 7-1/4, down 1/4.
